name: selkies-desktop
description: Open the local Selkies desktop in code-server with persistent client settings.

selkiesDesktop.url.description: Selkies URL. 'auto' always uses the current code-server origin at /proxy/3000/ so gateway authentication is reused; an absolute URL overrides it.

selkiesDesktop.openOnStartup.description: Automatically open Selkies after first installation, on every startup, or never.

selkiesDesktop.browserMode.description: Use the dedicated main-editor panel, prefer Integrated Browser when available, or require Integrated Browser.

selkiesDesktop.openLocation.description: Open the dedicated panel in the active editor group or beside it.

selkiesDesktop.pageZoom.description: Default page zoom for the dedicated panel or Integrated Browser. Later panel changes are retained.

selkiesDesktop.dataStorage.description: Integrated Browser storage scope used for cookies, localStorage, and cache.

selkiesDesktop.uiDpi.description: Selkies UI DPI written to browser localStorage before the page loads.

selkiesDesktop.hidpi.description: Enable Selkies HiDPI by disabling CSS scaling in client-side browser storage.

selkiesDesktop.showStatusBarButton.description: Show a one-click Selkies Desktop button in the status bar.
